one_month_reasoning: The Q3 2026 report is scheduled for 2026-11-02 (Alpha Vantage earnings calendar), i.e. AFTER the 2026-10-29 window, so no company-specific scheduled catalyst falls inside the month. In-window drivers are peer earnings (TXN/NXPI/STM/ADI-type analog and power reporters in late October, which set sentiment for auto/industrial), any pre-announcement (unlikely given Q3 guide $1.65-1.75B was reiterated in spirit at the Aug 27 Deutsche Bank conference with book-to-bill >1), the Synaptics HSR/regulatory process and ongoing merger-arb short pressure on ON. The stock has rebounded from $66.60 post-analyst-day (Sep 16) to $75.95; I do not have a directional edge, so I use a near-symmetric lognormal centred at ~$76.1 (tiny positive drift from revisions trending up: 21 up vs 1 down in 30 days on Q4 EPS) with ~16.5% monthly sigma (between 64% realized/3.5 = 18% and a calmer ~50% forward vol).

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (NTM EPS at Sep-2027 ~ $5.20 x 16x = $83) and FCF yield (NTM FCF/share ~ $4.90 at a 6% yield = $81.7), both treating the Synaptics deal (1.35 ON shares per SYNA share, ~12% dilution, close mid-2027) as roughly EPS-neutral in year one.

inputs_detail.derivation: Blend of CY27 $4.53 and CY28; CY28 standalone ~$5.45 = CY27 grown ~20% (analyst-day target: 12-14% revenue CAGR with operating income growing >2x revenue, GM 40.3% 2026E -> 53% 2030). Synaptics adds ~12% shares but deal guided accretive within 18 months with $200M synergies; I haircut ~4% for dilution in the first year post-close -> ~$5.20 NTM.

Current price $75.95 / CY27 consensus $4.53 = 16.8x; at the $120 June-24 VWAP cited in the S-4 fairness analysis the stock traded ~26x CY27. Deal overhang, cyclicality and execution risk on 2030 targets argue for staying near today's de-rated multiple rather than reverting to June levels; 16x NTM.

inputs_detail.value: $1.6B (25%) in 2026E; ~$3.5B (30-35% margin) 2030 target; capex ~5% of revenue

inputs_detail.derivation: CY27 consensus revenue $7.42B x ~27% FCF margin (between 2026E 25% and 30-35% target) = $2.0B; stepping forward half a year ~ $2.05B; Synaptics FCF plus partial synergies ~$0.15B.
395M Q3 diluted guide less ~2%/yr buybacks (Q2 buyback $332M; $5.3B authorization left) = ~390M, grossed up for ~12% Synaptics pro forma ownership -> ~445-450M.
At $75.95 and ~392M shares (~$30B cap) LTM FCF yield is ~5%; a 6% NTM yield reflects cyclical/merger risk. $2.2B/450M = $4.89 / 0.06 = $81.5.
Immaterial to per-share value (~$1.5/share); ignored in the yield calc.

bear.story: Analog/auto cycle rolls over again in 2027 after the pricing/restock bump, AI-DC ($>500M 2026) is too small to offset; gross margin stalls near 40%; Synaptics integration disappoints or regulatory delay keeps arb pressure on; ~12.5x on ~$4.00 EPS.

base.story: Utilization climbs from 83% toward 90%, two price increases flow through, GM reaches mid-40s by mid-2027, CY27 EPS ~$4.5 and NTM ~$5.2; Synaptics closes mid-2027 roughly neutral; multiple stays ~16x.

bull.story: AI data center doubles again in 2027 as guided, 800VDC/SiC/EPP wins broaden, book-to-bill stays >1 and GM tracks the 53% 2030 path; EPS ~$5.8 NTM re-rated to ~21x as the market regains confidence seen in June (~26x CY27).

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$52 the stock would trade ~11.5x CY27 consensus EPS and ~8% FCF yield on 2026E FCF; getting there most likely requires a guidance cut (demand/booking reversal, utilization falling back from 83%, pricing not sticking) or a materially worse Synaptics outcome, not ordinary volatility. It also sits near the post-deal washout low territory ($65.80 Sep 16) less another ~20%.

reasoning: Primary filings frame the setup: Q2 2026 (8-K, Aug 3) revenue $1,604M (+9% y/y), non-GAAP GM 39.3%, EPS $0.74, FCF $425M (27% margin), LTM FCF $1.50B on capex only ~3% of sales; Q3 guide $1.65-1.75B, GM 40-42%, EPS $0.81-0.93. The Aug 27 Deutsche Bank conference added utilization 68%->83%, two price increases, book-to-bill >1. The Sep 16 analyst-day deck (filed as a 425) sets 2030 targets ($11B rev, 53% GM, 38% OM, ~$3.5B FCF, 100% FCF return) and 2026E GM 40.3%/FCF $1.6B. Yet the stock fell from ~$125 to ~$90 in the week of the June 25 all-stock Synaptics announcement (EV ~$7B, 1.35x ratio, ~12% dilution) and to $66.60 after the analyst day; the S-4 shows the ratio sat above the top of several of Synaptics' own adviser's value ranges at ON's $120 VWAP, i.e. ON paid up, and merger-arb shorting likely weighs until the mid-2027 close. Consensus EPS is being revised up (CY26 $3.20, CY27 $4.53; 21 up/5 down in 30 days), so fundamentals are improving while the multiple de-rated to ~16.8x CY27. My fair value (~$82) blends 16x NTM EPS ~$5.20 and a 6% yield on ~$4.90 NTM FCF/share, modestly above spot. Scenarios bear $50 (25%) / base $83 (50%) / bull $125 (25%), mean ~$85. The ladder is a lognormal with median ~$80 and sigma ~0.52 (below the 64% realized, which is inflated by the deal-announcement crash, but well above a typical large cap), with slightly fattened left tail. Research limited to ~15 queries; Twelve Data analyst endpoints were unavailable on the plan so consensus came from Alpha Vantage.
